methods.method: Once an M15 bar closes, compare its MID with completed close 4 full NY17 sessions earlier; BUY on +3% if CASH, SELL on -3% if GOLD; execute at next completed M15 ASK/BID; month-end equal-cost liquidation

mean(abs(last five completed session log returns)) / mean(abs(last twenty completed session log returns))
